one_line_conclusion: External validation verdict: NOT CONFIRMED. HDFI was NOT elevated in ICH vs controls (GSE163256 d=-0.12, p=0.75; SAH blood anchor likewise NS, p=0.56); HDFI~Execution coupling did NOT replicate consistently: positive in ICH blood monocytes (rho=0.33) but inverse in ICH whole blood (rho=-0.36). HDFI is not yet validated as an independent case-vs-control blood biomarker; its link to ferroptosis execution appears cell-context dependent.
hdfi_formula: HDFI = z(HMOX1) - mean(z(FTH1),z(FTL)) - z(GPX4), z-scored within each cohort

interpretation.sah_anchor: SAH GSE36791 HDFI is the reused discovery anchor (same convention as 26_hdfi_centrepiece.py).
interpretation.gse163256: GSE163256 (independent human ICH blood monocytes, 101 ICH vs 5 control): HDFI showed lower HDFI in ICH than controls (Cohen d=-0.12, Mann-Whitney p=0.75 -> NOT significant); within-cohort Spearman(HDFI, ferroptosis Execution) rho=0.33, p=0.000558 -> significant positively.
interpretation.gse296792: GSE296792 (independent human ICH whole-blood RNA-seq, 77 samples, longitudinal, NO healthy controls so a case/control HDFI elevation CANNOT be tested): within-cohort Spearman(HDFI, ferroptosis Execution) rho=-0.36, p=0.00113 -> significant.

guardrail: Findings are reported as observed; no framing was tuned to obtain significance. HDFI is z-scored WITHIN each cohort, so absolute HDFI is not directly comparable across cohorts -- only within-cohort case/control contrasts and within-cohort HDFI~Execution correlations are legitimate.
